_metadata.warning: All thresholds are PROVISIONAL PLACEHOLDERS derived from the SME brief. Real NFL-level cutoffs require combine data, scout-validated ground truth, and statistical power analysis. Do NOT use these values for actual athlete selection decisions.
_metadata.validation_target: NFL combine data + scout-validated ground truth required before any threshold is treated as operational
_metadata.how_to_edit: Change numeric values in this file only. Do not edit screening_scaffold.py to adjust thresholds — the code reads this file at runtime.

notes: min_confidence: readings below this always yield NEEDS_REVIEW, regardless of angle value.
boundary_margin_default_deg: measurements within this distance of any threshold boundary yield NEEDS_REVIEW.

10° margin is calibrated from the cross-engine validation study (hip_extension_validation_2d.py), which found a mean absolute disagreement of 11.1° between BlazePose (MediaPipe) and RTMPose-m (Sports2D) in 2D image-coordinate space.
24fps clips add an additional ±5-10° timing error at toe-off; this is absorbed by the same margin.
Per SME brief D3: never force a hard DISQUALIFY verdict on weak or insufficient input.

A1_hip_extension_at_toeoff.display_name: Pattern A1 — Hip Extension at Toe-Off
A1_hip_extension_at_toeoff.description: Peak included hip angle (Knee–Hip–Shoulder, arccos convention) at the instant of toe-off during full-speed running. 180° = fully extended limb; angle decreases as the hip bends.

zone_explanation.QUALIFY (clear): measured_value >= clear_qualify_zone_deg (170°) — more than one margin above threshold
zone_explanation.NEEDS_REVIEW (boundary): measured_value within boundary_margin_deg (10°) of either threshold
zone_explanation.PARTIAL (always NEEDS_REVIEW): SME brief does not assign PARTIAL a definitive screening outcome
zone_explanation.DISQUALIFY (clear): measured_value <= clear_disqualify_zone_deg (135°) — more than one margin below threshold

validation_notes: Cross-engine MAD = 11.1° (2D pixel-space comparison, hip_extension_validation_2d.py) — supports 10° boundary margin.
24fps timing: ±42ms/frame → ~5-10° hip-angle error at toe-off; absorbed within the same 10° margin.
SME brief D3: quality-insufficient or implausible readings must be NEEDS_REVIEW, not DISQUALIFY.
PARTIAL maps to NEEDS_REVIEW because the SME brief does not assign it a definitive screening outcome.
NFL combine validation required before any threshold is used operationally.
